mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBER_ID AS id, m.MEMBER_NAME AS name, m.PHONE, m.JOINED_AT, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_ADMIN a WHERE REPLACE(a.PHONE, '-', '') = REPLACE(m.PHONE, '-', '') AND a.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_admin, (SELECT MAX(r.FROM_ADDRESS) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY r.REQUESTED_AT) FROM TBL_MOVE_REQUEST r WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID) AS last_address FROM TBL_MEMBER m WHERE m.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT -a.ADMIN_ID, a.ADMIN_NAME, a.PHONE, NULL, 'Y', NULL FROM TBL_ADMIN a WHERE a.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_MEMBER m WHERE REPLACE(m.PHONE, '-', '') = REPLACE(a.PHONE, '-', '') AND m.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y') ORDER BY 4 DESC NULLS LAST, 1 DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_MEMBER (MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, IS_VERIFIED, IS_ACTIVE, JOINED_AT, TERMS_AGREED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{phone}, 'N', 'Y', #{joined}, #{joined})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_ADMIN SET IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' WHERE REPLACE(PHONE, '-', '') = #{digits}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_ADMIN (ADMIN_ID, ADMIN_NAME, PHONE, IS_ACTIVE, PUSH_ENABLED, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_ADMIN.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{phone}, 'Y', 'Y', SYSDATE)
